entity.summary: LINE-backed global centralized cryptocurrency exchange operated by LVC USA Inc. It announced a phased voluntary shutdown on 2022-11-28 and scheduled withdrawals to end on 2023-03-31.
entity.notes: Entity death date uses the end of the announced withdrawal/service wind-down rather than the announcement date. LINE Blockchain's 2022-11-28 notice states that BITFRONT was being shut down to focus resources on the LINE Blockchain ecosystem; contemporary Reuters reporting independently corroborated the phased closure schedule.

events.title: BITFRONT announced a phased shutdown
events.description: LINE Blockchain announced that BITFRONT would shut down, with new sign-ups and credit-card payments suspended and the service proceeding through a phased wind-down ending with withdrawals on 2023-03-31.
events.notes: The operator framed the closure as a strategic voluntary shutdown rather than an insolvency or misconduct event.

events.title: BITFRONT withdrawal wind-down reached its announced end date
events.description: The shutdown schedule announced by BITFRONT set 2023-03-31 as the end date for withdrawals and the terminal point used by HEI for the service lifecycle.
events.notes: HEI uses the operator-published shutdown schedule as the lifecycle boundary.

evidence.title: [NOTICE] BITFRONT Exchange to Close
evidence.notes: First-party LINE Blockchain notice announcing the BITFRONT shutdown and explaining the operator's stated strategic rationale.

evidence.title: Crypto exchange Bitfront shuts down
evidence.notes: Independent contemporaneous report corroborating the phased closure and the announced 2023-03-31 withdrawal end date.

expected.summary: LINE-backed global centralized cryptocurrency exchange operated by LVC USA Inc. It announced a phased voluntary shutdown in late 2022 and scheduled withdrawals to end on 2023-03-31.
expected.notes: Entity death date uses the end of withdrawals and service termination rather than the announcement date.
